title: C2 Capstone: The Ultimate Exam
completion_message: ¡FELICITACIONES! Has superado el 'Capstone Exam' y dominado el nivel C2, el pináculo absoluto del idioma inglés. Has demostrado una elocuencia retórica perfecta, un vocabulario legal y financiero impecable, y una capacidad de liderazgo innegable. ¡Eres oficialmente bilingüe al más alto nivel profesional!

parts.visual:
Este es el hito final de tu viaje. 
En este 'Capstone Exam', evaluaremos los conceptos más avanzados y sofisticados del idioma inglés que has aprendido en el nivel C2: 

1. Inversión Negativa para efecto dramático (Not only did we win... / Under no circumstances should you...). 
2. Mixed Conditionals (If I had invested then, I would be rich now). 
3. Relative Clauses avanzadas y conectores (Whom, Of which, Whereby, Albeit, Insofar as).
parts.audio: This is the final milestone of your journey. In this Capstone Exam, we will evaluate the most advanced and sophisticated concepts of the English language that you have learned in the C2 level. We will test Negative Inversion for dramatic effect, such as 'Not only did we win', and 'Under no circumstances should you'. We will test Mixed Conditionals, like 'If I had invested then, I would be rich now'. We will also test advanced Relative Clauses and Connectors, like Whom, Of which, Whereby, Albeit, and Insofar as.

parts.visual:
También pondremos a prueba tu dominio del vocabulario corporativo supremo: 

4. Boardroom Politics & Crisis Management (C-Suite, Golden parachute, Scapegoat, Damage control). 
5. Legal English II (Indemnity, Force Majeure, Breach of contract, Due diligence). 
6. The Global Economy (Inflation, Quantitative Easing, Bear/Bull Market, GDP). 

Este es el paso final. ¡Demuestra que estás listo para liderar en el escenario global!
parts.audio: We will also test your mastery of supreme corporate vocabulary. This includes Boardroom Politics and Crisis Management, with terms like C-Suite, Golden parachute, Scapegoat, and Damage control. We will test Legal English, including Indemnity, Force Majeure, Breach of contract, and Due diligence. Finally, we will test The Global Economy, covering Inflation, Quantitative Easing, Bear and Bull Markets, and GDP. This is the final step. Show that you are ready to lead on the global stage!

stages.title: The Capstone Quiz
stages.description: Demuestra tu dominio absoluto en este examen final de C2.

questions.question: Normal: He had hardly entered the boardroom when the argument started. -> Inversion: Hardly ____ the boardroom when the argument started.
If they had accepted our initial offer in 2018, we ____ market leaders right now.
questions.explanation: Mixed conditional: Causa pasada (had accepted) -> Efecto presente (would be).

questions.question: The contractor failed to deliver the materials, which constitutes a clear ____ of contract.
questions.explanation: Breach of contract = incumplimiento de contrato.

questions.question: The central bank initiated a new round of Quantitative ____ to inject money into the struggling economy.
We bought out the competitor, ____ establishing a monopoly in the region. (Por lo tanto / De ese modo).
questions.explanation: Thereby = de ese modo (whereby = mediante el cual).

questions.question: ____ only did the CFO embezzle funds, but he also destroyed the evidence.
When the corruption scandal broke, the junior accountant was used as a ____ to protect the CEO.
The proposed merger is highly lucrative, ____ extremely risky. (Si bien / Aunque).
If I ____ Russian fluently, they would have sent me to the Moscow office last year.
questions.explanation: Mixed conditional: Si yo hablara ruso (habilidad general) -> me habrían enviado (pasado).

questions.question: Due to the unprecedented hurricane, the company invoked the Force ____ clause to suspend operations.
Under no circumstances ____ the server passwords with anyone outside the department.
questions.explanation: Under no circumstances + auxiliar + sujeto (should you share).

questions.question: The board forced him to resign, but he left with a $50 million golden ____.
The committee presented five options, none of ____ were financially viable. (De las cuales).
A steady rise in prices that erodes purchasing power is known as ____.
The employee who leaked the illegal practices to the press is protected by ____ laws. (Denunciante).
Before acquiring the startup, our lawyers must conduct thorough due ____. (Auditoría previa).
Little ____ realize that the microphone was still on during his private conversation.
questions.explanation: Little + auxiliar + sujeto (Little did he realize).

questions.question: They signed an agreement ____ the supplier will offer a 10% discount on bulk orders. (Mediante el cual).
The sudden drop in tech stocks signals the beginning of a ____ market. (Mercado bajista).
His lack of formal education ____, he built a billion-dollar empire. (A pesar de / No obstante su falta...).
Not only (we won) -> Not only ____ ____ win.
If I had bought it, I ____ be rich now. (Usa: would)
None of ____. (Ninguno de los cuales - cosas)
Successful, ____ expensive. (Aunque - formal con A)
____ of contract. (Incumplimiento con B)
A golden ____. (Indemnización millonaria con P)
A ____ market. (Mercado alcista con B)
A corporate ____. (Denunciante con W)
Due ____. (Auditoría/Diligencia con D)
Force ____. (Fuerza mayor con M)

stages.title: Listening Comprehension
stages.description: Prueba auditiva definitiva para graduarte del nivel C2.

Not only we won, we dominated.
